purpose: Executable ledger for the `route-state-core` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: same boundary data or dual reconstruction
controls.expected_failure_mode: candidate identity collapses to quotient rather than unique presentation
controls.candidate_native_difference: different ontology labels may be same quotient or empirically indistinguishable
controls.required_discriminator: declare quotient and invariant carrier before same/different claim

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: accurate reconstruction inside selected code space
controls.expected_failure_mode: success evaporates outside selected regime
controls.candidate_native_difference: candidate-native target is narrower than public story
controls.required_discriminator: out-of-code-space and finite-N stress tests

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: benchmark recovery with low error
controls.missing_target_property: identification rather than inherited simulator target
controls.expected_failure_mode: pipeline learns assumed equation/target instead of identifying it
controls.candidate_native_difference: native route absent; public record is generated by assumed model
controls.required_discriminator: fresh public data and surrogate-target audit

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: correct field equation or entropy relation
controls.expected_failure_mode: many microscopic theories recover same equation
controls.candidate_native_difference: same public equation, different native substrate
controls.required_discriminator: native record/inverse route for microscopic target

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: phenomenologically attractive compactification
controls.borrowed_support_or_surrogate: landscape and selection after the fact
controls.expected_failure_mode: fit is selected rather than predicted
controls.candidate_native_difference: different vacua share public features
controls.required_discriminator: predeclared vacuum-selection and parameter-fixation test

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: apparently distinct formal descriptions
controls.missing_target_property: different candidates rather than dual presentations
controls.expected_failure_mode: presentation multiplicity misread as ontology multiplicity or uniqueness
controls.candidate_native_difference: same quotient under duality may wear different variables
controls.required_discriminator: duality quotient ledger and invariant-carrier test

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: fixed point in a truncation
controls.expected_failure_mode: fixed point may be artifact or incomplete corridor
controls.candidate_native_difference: native target changes with ansatz/regulator
controls.required_discriminator: cross-truncation/regulator and matter recovery tests

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: continuum-like causal statistics
controls.expected_failure_mode: many microscopic orders approximate same continuum
controls.candidate_native_difference: same large-scale record with different microdynamics
controls.required_discriminator: native quantum-growth and inverse tests

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: satisfies amplitude/positivity/bootstrap constraints
controls.expected_failure_mode: many theories obey the same consistency bounds
controls.candidate_native_difference: constraint corridor is not unique ontology
controls.required_discriminator: measured coefficient plus attribution and exclusion wedge
controls.state_machine_effect: caps at S2 unless named exclusion

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: gravity-mediated entanglement or related correlations
controls.expected_failure_mode: positive signal does not uniquely determine fundamental mediator ontology
controls.candidate_native_difference: same or similar lab signal under alternative mediator dynamics
controls.required_discriminator: mediator-dynamics probes beyond entanglement-only witness

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: LOCC-style entanglement-witness inference
controls.expected_failure_mode: gauge/dressing constraints complicate independence assumptions
controls.candidate_native_difference: public lab statistics remain but ontology inference weakens
controls.required_discriminator: AQFT/subsystem-independence disclosure and effective-split justification

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: no deviation from GR in strong-field waveforms
controls.borrowed_support_or_surrogate: GR baseline and many-to-one low-energy limit
controls.expected_failure_mode: many candidates reduce to GR in tested regime
controls.candidate_native_difference: same waveform constraints under multiple candidates
controls.required_discriminator: deviation-specific attribution or independent quantum-gravity target

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: sharp record in one frame
controls.expected_failure_mode: record fails under cross-frame transport
controls.candidate_native_difference: one-frame publicness not equivalent to frame-independent publicness
controls.required_discriminator: frame-pair operational equivalence and challenge route

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: a detector records a single-quantum-like transition correlated with a gravitational-wave trigger
controls.missing_target_property: unique quantum-gravity candidate or full mediator ontology
controls.borrowed_support_or_surrogate: ordinary quantum-detector semantics and interaction-model assumptions
controls.expected_failure_mode: single-click access supports quantum interaction/discriminator credit but not ToE identity
controls.public_record_similarity: high if the event is publicly recorded and correlated
controls.candidate_native_difference: different candidate ontologies can share the same low-energy single-graviton effective interaction
controls.required_discriminator: candidate-native target quotient plus alternative interaction/source controls beyond event detection
controls.state_machine_effect: blocks S4/S5; at most S3 discriminator pocket if realized and replayable

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: graviton-counting statistics distinguish coherent, squeezed, thermal, or other gravitational-wave state classes
controls.missing_target_property: candidate-level identity of the gravitational sector
controls.borrowed_support_or_surrogate: source model, Gaussian-state/tomography assumptions, and detector-response model
controls.expected_failure_mode: state characterization identifies the radiation state or source class rather than the underlying ToE ontology
controls.public_record_similarity: medium/high for public counting distributions and reconstructed statistics
controls.candidate_native_difference: multiple quantum-gravity candidates can predict the same low-energy radiation-state statistics
controls.required_discriminator: cross-candidate model comparison with native record semantics and observed-sector integration
controls.state_machine_effect: keeps route at S2/S3 discriminator credit; blocks candidate-native closure

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: a single-system or constrained-dynamics precursor appears to verify the conditions from which GIE would follow
controls.missing_target_property: direct two-system gravitational entanglement record and mediator ontology are not observed in the same public experiment
controls.borrowed_support_or_surrogate: quantum-information theorem, assumed Schrödinger dynamics, constrained mechanical implementation, or forecasted visibility
controls.expected_failure_mode: indirect proof or feasibility relaxation is exported as direct mediator quantumness or ToE identification
controls.public_record_similarity: published interferometer phase / visibility / dynamics data can look like a GIE route record
controls.candidate_native_difference: the candidate still has not supplied a native target quotient, subsystem model, public bridge, or mediator ontology
controls.required_discriminator: separate direct-entanglement, subsystem-independence, classical/hybrid, decoherence, and nuisance controls from indirect precursor success
controls.state_machine_effect: positive precursor evidence may strengthen S2/S3 discriminator readiness but cannot exceed discriminator S3 pocket or erase residual cap

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: forecasted future detector sensitivity or simulated beyond-GR constraint is narrated as already acquired public evidence
controls.missing_target_property: real public detector record with calibration, selection, waveform, and population systematics has not yet been acquired
controls.borrowed_support_or_surrogate: mission design study, Fisher forecast, parameterized-post-Einsteinian template, or simulated source catalog
controls.expected_failure_mode: forecast-public sensitivity is laundered into empirical-delta or candidate-identification credit
controls.public_record_similarity: forecast tables and simulated likelihoods resemble observation summaries
controls.candidate_native_difference: future sensitivity is an acquisition plan, not an observed candidate-native record or unique inverse
controls.required_discriminator: separate forecast, realized observation, catalog likelihood, and model-specific deviation before route-state changes
controls.state_machine_effect: forecast entries can create decision experiments but not route promotion until empirical deltas name acquired records

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: a phenomenological parameterization fits late-time expansion better than Lambda-CDM and is retold as candidate support
controls.missing_target_property: candidate-native derivation of the parameterization and observed-sector bridge
controls.borrowed_support_or_surrogate: w0-wa or other surrogate model, combined likelihood, or post-hoc parameter fit
controls.expected_failure_mode: parameter-fit improvement becomes dark-energy ontology or ToE evidence by summary
controls.public_record_similarity: distance-redshift likelihoods and posterior contours are public and numerically sharp
controls.candidate_native_difference: many candidate packages and nuisance choices can induce the same public likelihood
controls.required_discriminator: derive the parameterization from the candidate, show robustness across data combinations, and preserve many-to-one residual cap
controls.state_machine_effect: keeps the cosmology route at S2 constraint corridor until the native derivation and inverse quotient are supplied

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: cross-survey tension is treated as new cosmological physics
controls.missing_target_property: systematics-resistant public record and candidate-specific predicted deviation
controls.borrowed_support_or_surrogate: survey calibration, selection function, supernova sample choice, CMB prior, or nuisance covariance
controls.expected_failure_mode: pipeline or combination dependence is mistaken for a candidate-native delta
controls.public_record_similarity: the result is a real public catalog/likelihood tension
controls.candidate_native_difference: candidate identity is not fixed until the tension survives nuisance, selection, and parameterization alternatives
controls.required_discriminator: robustness across independent survey pipelines, nuisance priors, and alternate observables
controls.state_machine_effect: blocks promotion above S2 when systematics or data-combination dependence remains load-bearing

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: B-mode-like signal or forecasted sensitivity is retold as primordial tensor evidence
controls.missing_target_property: foreground-, lensing-, calibration-, and null-channel-robust primordial record
controls.borrowed_support_or_surrogate: foreground cleaning model, delensing forecast, sky mask, or assumed noise model
controls.expected_failure_mode: contamination or forecasted reach becomes early-universe candidate support
controls.public_record_similarity: maps, likelihoods, and r constraints look like decisive public records
controls.candidate_native_difference: candidate target remains many-to-one even after a robust tensor likelihood
controls.required_discriminator: multi-frequency foreground, delensing, calibration, and null-channel controls before route-state effects
controls.state_machine_effect: keeps the primordial tensor route at S2 unless the public record survives foreground/lensing controls and still only constrains a class

controls.positive_pattern_mimicked: a tensor detection or tight bound is treated as unique support for one early-universe or quantum-gravity candidate
controls.missing_target_property: unique inverse from tensor spectrum to candidate ontology
controls.borrowed_support_or_surrogate: inflationary model family, reheating prior, spectral-index convention, or non-inflationary early-universe assumption
controls.expected_failure_mode: class constraint is exported as candidate identity
controls.public_record_similarity: a clean r detection/bound can be an extremely salient public result
controls.candidate_native_difference: multiple candidate mechanisms can share the same tensor-spectrum record
controls.required_discriminator: additional spectrum, tilt, non-Gaussianity, reheating, or independent early-universe records that shrink the quotient
controls.state_machine_effect: permits S2 constraint strengthening but blocks candidate-native identifiability language
